0.reason: the bundled column assertion still fails when the migration drops payload, which is the column it adds

1.reason: a receipt header label; the after-measurement's worktree revision is recorded in its own log

findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion `{"run_id", "payload", "base_sha"} <= columns` bundles two columns the test itself writes in _LEGACY_RUNS with the one the migration adds, so only "payload" can fail and the other two hold whatever the migration does.

non-blocking: the header names revision 3a5fceb44c0538bfcaee3334ab72dd27ebc5d729 although the after-measurement ran in the worktree at 78b91378df, so a reader dating the fix from the header attributes the after-open figures to the base commit.

non-blocking: _STORE_SCHEMA_VERSION hashes only the schema declarations, so a later repair to the backfill logic in _migrate_runs that changes no declaration will not re-run against an already-recorded store and leaves those rows migrated by the earlier logic.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3a5fceb44c0538bfcaee3334ab72dd27ebc5d729; 78b91378df adds a store_meta table to _AUX_SCHEMA, a sha256 _STORE_SCHEMA_VERSION over the declarations at reckon/run_store.py:129, the record check at :288 and two private helpers, plus the 220-line test file, and ae97d1d95a adds the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a new test showing a promotion on an already-migrated temporary home calls no migration step counted by a wrapper, and a home without the record migrating once; tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_migrate_the_run_store_every_call.py:113 and :122 assert exactly that against a wrapper installed on run_store.RunStore._migrate_runs at :75, and I re-ran the file and got 4 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a promotion on an already-migrated home runs no run-store migration step; reckon/run_store.py:288 returns from RunStore._create once the recorded declaration version matches, so a second open on the same home skips _migrate_runs entirely.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the two commits, the base and head arms at EXIT=0 (51 and 55 passed), the importer arms at 5 failed / 472 and 476 passed, and the negative control at 3 failed 1 passed EXIT=1, each naming its log under the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/run_store.py, tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_migrate_the_run_store_every_call.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git show --stat over 3a5fceb..ae97d1d95a lists only the first three, and no figure was written because the done-when names none.

justifications.durability: dropping the record check from RunStore._create makes tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_migrate_the_run_store_every_call.py:113 fail on a counted pass of 1 where 0 is owed, but :181's column assertion carries two members the test itself created.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-base.log and logs/gate-head.log record the wrapper-counted measure with an EXIT= line, but logs/repro-after.log:1 stamps the base revision on a measurement taken in the head worktree.
justifications.fit: the change extends the module's own _AUX_SCHEMA declaration and the with self._conn: transaction idiom used by RunStore.append at reckon/run_store.py:352, and names its new symbols by mechanism with no plan or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/run_store.py:288 checks the recorded version before calling _migrate_runs and :289 records it only after the pass returns, which is the deliverable the section states.
justifications.reuse: no owner of a versioned migration record exists here - reckon/crew/station_store.py:394 tracks columns by PRAGMA rather than by a recorded version, and no module in reckon/ uses PRAGMA user_version - so reckon/run_store.py:110 adds the first and extends the existing declaration rather than forking a store.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/run_store.py, tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_migrate_the_run_store_every_call.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-promotion-does-not-migrate-the-run-store-every-call.html) is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the change adds no companion-table work beyond the one store_meta row.
